question.text: Surcharge for a Trust-structured Cat III AIF with total income > Rs. 2 crore (individual taxpayer rules apply) is:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.1, surcharge is 25% for Trust-structured AIF with income > Rs. 2 crore (AoP treatment applies for Trusts). **The Trap:** 37% was for individuals > Rs. 5 crore before new tax regime; 10%/15% for smaller incomes. **Cross-Exam Context:** Trusts treated as AOPs, capped at 25%. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** New tax regime caps surcharge at 25% — factor this in post-tax ROI computations.
